properties.name: An agent chasing 'how deep should a decomposition go' answered it from the wrong population FOUR times in one session; every correction came from Anthony, none from a mechanism, and each measurement was individually sound
properties.statement:
COUNTED 2026-08-25 across one session, because four instances of one shape is a pattern rather than four mistakes.

THE QUESTION: how deep should a design's decomposition go, and what should carry depth. Four answers were produced. **Every measurement behind them was arithmetically correct. Every one answered a question about the wrong population, and Anthony caught all four.**

**1. REFLOW2'S OWN STATISTICS USED TO DECIDE FOR USERS.** Concluded "at 4% spine population, deriving depth is unusable and declaring is the only thing that works." He: *"we can use reflow2 as a litmus test for what is right, but I want to do what is right for people using reflow2 on their own projects."*
⇒ On re-measurement the 4% was wrong TWICE OVER: the denominator counted ChangeEvents and TemporalFacts that were never meant to be in a decomposition spine, and the figure was stale. **The real number is 100% of components.** The conclusion built on it was backwards.

**2. A CONTAMINATED SAMPLE READ AS EVIDENCE.** Measured seven reflow2 designs, concluded "real designs are two rungs deep, so the floor was reflow2's problem, not a user's." He: *"most of these are after the fact... they were developed before reflow2 really started defining rungs."*
⇒ Evidence of what happens with NO guidance, presented as evidence of what users need.

**3. ORGANIC STRUCTURE READ AS DESIGNED STRUCTURE.** Measured the bluesky stack, chosen precisely as an outside case, and reported "five core repos, inside 3–7, and independent lifecycles draw the same cut — two rules agreeing." He: *"the bluesky stack has grown somewhat organically... it was never designed from a systems engineering perspective."*
⇒ **Conway's Law — rule 3 of the same doctrine — PREDICTS that split with no SE at all.** Two of the four rules cannot tell a designed system from a grown one, because one of them is about growth. The agreement was not corroboration.

**4. ARTIFACTS MEASURED INSTEAD OF DOCTRINE CONSULTED.** Four rounds of measurement before anyone asked what the discipline actually prescribes. He: *"this is more a systems engineering 101 type discussion... what does the doctrine say we should do?"*
⇒ Doctrine answers it directly and differently: structure is DERIVED from functional allocation, and span of control is a CHECK on the result, not a generator of it. **The machinery already existed — `propose_allocation` clusters capabilities by coupling — and four rounds of measuring never touched it.**

⭐⭐ THE SHAPE, WHICH IS THE POINT: every instance is REASONING FROM AN AVAILABLE POPULATION RATHER THAN THE RELEVANT ONE. reflow2's graph was available, so it stood in for users' graphs. Existing designs were available, so they stood in for well-made designs. A file tree was available, so it stood in for a decomposition. Measurement was available, so it stood in for doctrine. **The failure is never in the arithmetic; it is in the silent substitution of the sample you can reach for the sample you need.**

🛑 AND NOT ONE OF THE FOUR WAS CAUGHT BY A MECHANISM. Not by a detector, not by a gate, not by a tool refusing an argument. All four were caught by the person, in conversation, by knowing the domain. `coverage_report` exists to ask "what could this check not have seen" and was never reached for, because nothing about a confident measurement suggests asking.

📌 WHY IT IS FILED HERE: this is the same shape as the three-legs finding at a different layer. That one measured that vocabulary never reaches a user's project unless a tool, an instruction and a detector all exist. This measures that ANALYSIS never reaches a user's project either — an agent with a graph in front of it will characterise that graph and present the result as general. The population is a third thing that has to be chosen deliberately, and nothing in reflow2 asks which one you are standing in.

📌 BOUNDS: one session, one agent, one domain expert correcting. Whether the same shape appears without a domain expert in the room is exactly what cannot be measured from inside it — and is the reason this is worth recording rather than absorbing.
